# Salamander Grand Piano samples

Piano recording: **Salamander Grand Piano**, Yamaha C5, by **Alexander Holm**.

License: **Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)**.
License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode

Source MP3 files: https://github.com/Tonejs/audio/tree/master/salamander
Source license notice: https://github.com/Tonejs/audio/blob/master/salamander/README
Distribution: https://tonejs.github.io/audio/salamander/

This app includes 21 of the distributed MP3 samples, from C2 through C7 in minor-third steps, unchanged. The app performs pitch shifting, velocity gain, attack, decay and release during playback. No endorsement by the author is implied.

To replace the instrument, update `src/audio/sampleLoader.ts` with properly licensed sample URLs and their original MIDI pitches. Sample files are bundled locally; playback does not send song or device data to the sample provider.
